name: SAM 3.1
notes: Released 2026-03-27. Object Multiplex: shared-memory multi-object tracking, faster joint tracking vs SAM 3. ComfyUI core PR #13408 merged. Weight swap only. Text+exemplar prompts retained. Supersedes current SAM3 checkpoint.

name: HyperSwap 256 ONNX (facefusion/models-3.3.0)
notes: Mid-2025 model, now standard in ComfyUI-ReActor 0.6+. 2x resolution (256 vs 128). Three variants: hyperswap_1a_256.onnx (speed), hyperswap_1b_256.onnx (balanced), hyperswap_1c_256.onnx (quality). Place in ComfyUI/models/hyperswap/. Supersedes inswapper_128.onnx. No InsightFace C++ build required.

name: HunyuanVideo 1.5
notes: Released 2025-11-24. 8.3B params, Selective and Sliding Tile Attention (SSTA), built-in video super-resolution network, FP8 gemm inference. Weight swap if spellcaster is not already on 1.5. GitHub: Tencent-Hunyuan/HunyuanVideo-1.5.

name: Qwen-Image-2.0 + DiffSynth ControlNets
notes: Released Feb 2026. Qwen3-VL encoder (vs Qwen2.5-VL in 2512), 1K-token prompts, multilingual text rendering. DiffSynth ControlNets for canny/depth/inpaint added March 2026. Union LoRA (lineart/openpose). Native ComfyUI support. Model file swap from Qwen-Image-2512. Paper: https://hf.co/papers/2605.10730

name: SeedVR2 v2.5
notes: Incremental March 2026 update over SeedVR2. Q6/Q8 GGUF quants confirmed fit on 16 GB RTX 5060 Ti. Same node pack (numz/ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler). Check repo for latest checkpoint filename.

name: LTX Video 2.3
notes: Released March 2026. 22B params, native audio-video sync, portrait 9:16, 4K/50fps output, spatial and temporal upscalers. Fits 16 GB per official docs with FP8 quantisation. Requires ComfyUI-LTXVideo node pack update (>=v0.16.1) and new weight download. Supersedes previous LTX Video checkpoint.

name: Ideogram 4 open-weight 9.3B (GGUF/NVFP4)
notes: Base model June 3 2026; GGUF quants (rectangleworm, molbal) released June 12-14 IN WINDOW; LoRAs active this week (DeverStyle/Ideogram-4.0-Loras 862 dl, RazzzHF/Realism_Engine 93 likes). NextDiT/Lumina2-family + Qwen3-VL-8B encoder. Structured JSON prompts (colour palette, bounding-box, text placement). Native ComfyUI 0.24.0. GGUF Q4/Q8 or NVFP4 fits 16 GB. LICENCE: non-commercial (Ideogram NCMA) - note in docstring. Also: Ideogram4-Inpaint-LoRA released June 14.

name: Microsoft Lens 3.8B (Lens / Lens-Turbo)
notes: Released June 1 2026 via ComfyUI 0.23.0. 3.8B dual-stream MMDiT + GPT-OSS-20B text encoder + FLUX.2 VAE. 3 variants: Base (50-step), Standard (20-step), Turbo (4-step). FLUX.1-dev-class quality at 19% training compute. GPT-OSS-20B encoder CPU-offloadable; fits 16 GB with offload. New Lens ComfyUI nodes in 0.23.0. GitHub: microsoft/Lens.

name: WAN 2.7 (Alibaba, Partner Nodes)
notes: Released 2026-04-03 via ComfyUI Partner Nodes. Fully multimodal: text+image+audio+video inputs. Up to 5 real-person image references, vocal timbre reference, 3x3 grid generation, 1080P output, MoE architecture. API-only (no local weights published as of June 14). ComfyUI 0.18.5 added support. Supersedes WAN 2.1, 2.2, 2.6 for all four task types.

name: Seedance 2.0 (ByteDance, Partner Nodes)
notes: Released 2026-04-13. Cinema-grade 2K output, native audio-video sync, FLF interpolation, T2V, I2V, reference-to-video. Multi-shot storytelling. API-only Partner Node. Additive to build_wan_flf; competitive for first-last-frame use case.

name: TripoSplat (VAST-AI, image to 3D Gaussian Splat)
notes: Released June 1 2026 via ComfyUI 0.23.0. Image to 3D Gaussian Splat output (.ply/.splat/.spz/.ksplat). Native GAUSSIAN type and manipulation nodes in ComfyUI. Up to 262,144 Gaussians. Unreal/Unity/Blender (SuperSplat/SparkJS) compatible. Additive to Hunyuan3D builders - different output format (splat vs mesh).

name: BFS-Best-Face-Swap LoRA series (Alissonerdx)
notes: Nov 2025; last updated March 2026. BFS Face V1-V5 (face-only) + BFS Head V1-V5 (full head/hair). Generative diffusion LoRA on Klein/FLUX.2. No 128px crop limit; better hair edge blending, lighting, skin tone. 345K+ downloads, 615 likes. MIT licence. Klein 4B ~8-12 GB VRAM. New paradigm vs ONNX inswapper - new builder needed.

name: ComfyUI-PuLID-Flux2 v0.6.2
notes: March 2026, v0.6.2. Extends PuLID face-ID injection to FLUX.2 Klein (4B/9B) and Dev variants. EVA-CLIP + InsightFace embedding into double-stream attention blocks. Klein 4B: ~8-10 GB VRAM. Klein 9B: ~14-15 GB (tight but within 16 GB). Separate node pack install required.

name: ToonOut BiRefNet ONNX (sprited)
notes: IN WINDOW: ONNX model released June 12 2026. BiRefNet fine-tuned on anime/cartoon dataset. Better pixel accuracy on animated characters vs BiRefNet-general (hair, linework, transparent areas). ONNX format: fast CPU/GPU inference, <4 GB VRAM. ComfyUI-RMBG already supports ToonOut. Additive option - set model to ToonOut for anime content.

name: PixelDiT 1300M (NVIDIA, pixel-space DiT)
notes: Released June 1 2026 via ComfyUI 0.23.0. 1.3B pixel-space DiT (no VAE decode step). Gemma 2B text encoder. CVPR 2026 Best Paper Finalist. Very VRAM-friendly. LICENCE: NSCLv1 non-commercial only - note in docstring. New PixelDiT + ResolutionSelector ComfyUI nodes. Additive experimental builder. ComfyUI weights: Comfy-Org/PixelDiT.

name: HiDream-O1-Image (Meituan, 6B unified, MIT)
notes: Open-sourced 2026-05-08; active ComfyUI ecosystem June 2026. 6B Pixel-level Unified Transformer (UiT): T2I + instruction editing + subject-driven personalisation + storyboard in one model. MIT licence. FP8 quant ~10 GB VRAM (drbaph/HiDream-O1-Image-FP8). Requires HiDream_O1-ComfyUI node pack (Saganaki22/HiDream_O1-ComfyUI). LoRA training nodes available.

name: Ideogram 4 Inpaint LoRA
notes: IN WINDOW: Released June 14 2026. ComfyUI-compatible inpainting LoRA adapter for Ideogram 4 (ai-toolkit trained). Additive once build_ideogram4_txt2img is wired. Depends on Ideogram 4 base model install.

name: FLUX.2 [dev] 32B (Black Forest Labs)
notes: VRAM BLOCKER: ~64 GB at FP16; 32B parameters. Multi-reference, 4MP editing, open-weight. No confirmed production-quality 16 GB quantisation. Klein variants (4B/9B) already in spellcaster and serve same use case within budget. Monitor Q4 GGUF quality.

name: ERNIE-Image 8B (Baidu, Apache-2.0)
notes: VRAM BLOCKER: 24 GB required at full precision. Released April 15 2026. Apache-2.0 (commercially friendly). Best-in-class EN+ZH text rendering, competitive with FLUX on quality. GGUF variants exist (unsloth/ERNIE-Image-GGUF) but quality at 16 GB unverified. Native ComfyUI 0.24.0. Revisit if Q4 GGUF quality proven viable.

name: V-RMBG 3.0 (Bria AI, video-native background removal)
notes: IN WINDOW: Announced June 10 2026 via press release. Video-native temporal background removal; uses previous frame output as context so edges stay stable across frames. 63%+ win-rate vs competitors. No confirmed open HF model card as of June 14 - possibly commercial/API-gated. Monitor briaai HF collection for open weight release.

name: Qwen-Image-Flash (few-step distillation)
notes: IN WINDOW: Paper published June 2 2026. Few-step distillation of Qwen-Image-2.0 with training-recipe improvements (data composition, teacher guidance, task mixture). Dramatically faster T2I and I2I inference. Weights NOT yet published as of June 14 - watch QwenLM/Qwen-Image on GitHub. Move to Tier 1 when weights land.

name: HSA - Heterogeneous Step Allocation for WAN/LTX
notes: Paper 2026-05-07. Training-free 50-75% runtime reduction on WAN-2 and LTX-2 via variable denoising step budgets per spatiotemporal token. KV-cache synchronisation preserves quality. No ComfyUI node yet. Could supersede WAN BlockSwap when implemented. Watch ernestchu/hsa GitHub.

name: DreamID-V (DiT-based video face swap)
notes: Paper January 2026; 53 HF upvotes. First DiT-based video face swap: SyncID-Pipe data pipeline, Modality-Aware Conditioning, Identity-Coherence RL, IDBench-V benchmark. No open weights confirmed. Likely >16 GB VRAM (video DiT). Monitor for code/weight release.

name: LongLive-RAG (retrieval-augmented long video)
notes: IN WINDOW: Paper June 1 2026. Addresses error accumulation in autoregressive video generation (FramePack's main weakness) via retrieval-augmented generation over latent history. No ComfyUI node or public weights yet. Directly targets build_framepack_video quality degradation.

name: SurGe (monocular surface geometry estimation)
notes: Paper 2026-05-29. Point Gradient Matching Loss + Neighborhood Attention Decoder. Best average rank across 8 zero-shot monocular geometry benchmarks for both depth AbsRel and surface normals. No public weights or ComfyUI node released yet. Watch for code release.

name: NTIRE 2026 Face Restoration Challenge winners
notes: Paper April 2026 (CVPR 2026 Denver). 10 valid teams; notable approach: DiffBIR+CodeFormer MoE ensemble with lightweight gating network, evaluated with AdaFace identity checker. Individual team weights expected to release post-CVPR. Watch HF and GitHub for team repos. Once available, evaluate vs standalone CodeFormer.

name: Relit-LiVE (video relighting, IC-Light successor)
notes: Paper 2026-05-07 + GitHub code (zhuxing0/Relit-LiVE). Video relighting without camera poses; raw reference images recover scene cues; generates per-frame environment maps. Video-first - VRAM likely >16 GB. No ComfyUI node. Monitor for still-image variant or ComfyUI port.

name: BFS-Best-Face-Swap-Video IC-LoRA (LTX-2.3 base)
notes: Jan 2026; updated March 2026. IC-LoRA on LTX-2.3 for temporally-consistent video face swap. 704x1216 target res fits 16 GB; 4K needs more VRAM. Requires LTX-2.3 base. Verify 16 GB viability at 704px resolution before promoting to Tier 2.
